app.name: JabeX
app.privacyNote: All data stays on your device.

home.description: Study with a private Leitner box. Switch local profiles on this device, and back up with a portable .jbx file — no account required.
home.ctaHint: Aim for under 30 seconds — name it and start adding cards next.

decks.title: Decks
decks.description: Organize flashcards into decks for focused study.
decks.createHint: Give the deck a short name. You can add cards right after.
decks.renameHint: Update the deck name. Cards stay in place.
decks.deleteHint: “{name}” and its cards will be removed from this profile.
decks.name: Name
decks.emptyHint: Create a deck to start your Leitner box — usually under 30 seconds.
decks.desktopOnly: Decks are available in the desktop app.

review.title: Review
review.description: Study due cards. Correct answers move up a Leitner box; misses return to box 1.
review.emptyHint: Add cards in a deck, or come back when reviews are due.
review.sessionDoneHint: You reviewed {count} cards. Great work — data stayed on this device.
review.revealHint: Space or Enter to show the answer

shortcuts.hint: Keys 1–4 grade the card. Space or Enter grades Good.

review.desktopOnly: Review is available in the desktop app.

cards.description: Add front/back flashcards to this deck.
cards.createHint: Write a prompt on the front and the answer on the back.
cards.editHint: Update the front and back text. Review progress stays the same.
cards.deleteHint: “{front}” will be removed from this deck.
cards.emptyHint: Add a few cards, then start a review — aim for under 2 minutes to first session.
cards.desktopOnly: Cards are available in the desktop app.
cards.notFound: This deck could not be found.

profiles.label: Profile
profiles.createHint: Each profile keeps its own decks and progress on this device.

backup.title: Backup
backup.importHint: Import creates a new local profile and loads the backup into it.
backup.desktopOnly: Backup is available in the desktop app.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Application behaviour for this device. Study data stays in your local profile.
settings.desktopOnly: Settings are available in the desktop app.

application.title: Application
application.description: System tray and startup options. These apply to the whole device, not a single profile.
application.enableTrayHint: Keep a JabeX icon near the Windows clock so the app can run in the background.
application.closeToTrayHint: The window X hides JabeX instead of quitting. Use Exit JabeX from the tray menu to quit.
application.startMinimizedHint: Launch hidden in the tray (requires tray enabled).
application.launchOnStartupHint: Start JabeX when you sign in to Windows (current user only).
